title: Darkroom Streams Angel Densetsu Anime
content: The two-part OAV originally debuted in September 1996. Darkroom describes the OAV : Upon transferring to Hekikuu High School, Kitano soon discovers that his pale skin, sharp features, and awkward social skills make everyone assume he is a vicious delinquent or drug addict.
author: ANN

title: Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend Film Streams 1st 4 Minutes
content: The staff for Seishun Buta Yarō wa Dear Friend no Yume o Minai ( Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend ) film, the latest anime of Hajime Kamoshida 's Rascal Does Not Dream (Seishun Buta Yarō or Aobuta) novel series, began streaming the film's first four minutes and posted a "finale visual" on Sunday.
author: ANN

title: Zoids Franchise Announces New Zoids: Chaotic Century Manga
content: The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for Takara Tomy 's Zoids franchise announced on Friday that a new manga tentatively titled Zoids: Chaotic Century Kanketsu-hen (Zoids: Chaotic Century Final Chapter) is currently in the works. More details about the manga will be announced at a later date.
author: ANN

title: Blue Box Season 2 Creditless Opening and Ending Videos Revealed
content: Blue Box Season 2 revealed the creditless opening and ending video sequences following its premiere on October 4, 2026. Singer aiko is performing “Anata no Hana no Iro” for the opening theme song, while the band elsewhere kikou sings “blue in” for the ending theme song. You can watch the opening below.

title: Suikoden Anime to Stream on YouTube with English Subtitles
content: The official English YouTube channel for Suikoden: The Anime , the adaptation of Konami 's Suikoden II game's story, announced in a video on Saturday the series will stream with English subtitles on YouTube for free beginning October 6 with new episodes on Tuesdays.
author: ANN

title: Amazon Prime Video Streams The Seven Knights of the Marronnier Kingdom Anime With Same-Day English Dub
content: Amazon Prime Video added the television anime of Nao Iwamoto 's Marronnier Ōkoku no Shichinin no Kishi ( The Seven Knights of the Marronnier Kingdom ) manga on Saturday, with English subtitles along with an English dub .
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll Streams New Sgt. Frog TV Anime
content: Crunchyroll added Keroro Gunsō ☆ , an all-new Sgt. Frog television anime , to the streaming service with English subtitles on Friday. The company is streaming the anime under the title KERORO☆ , and is streaming the series worldwide except in Asia. The anime features an all-new cast for the franchise.
author: ANN

title: 5 Major Reveals We Could See at Jump Festa 2027
content: Shueisha is gearing up for one of its biggest events of the year, Jump Festa, which is a prominent event for fans to learn about various updates for Shonen Jump franchises, covering both anime and manga. The event is all set for the December 19-20 weekend, and the lineup for the event has also been unveiled.
author: ComicBook

title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 Is Back With the Elements That Prove It’s Still a Masterpiece
content: The Fall 2026 season has arrived, and with its first weekend, it has also brought back everyone’s favorite drama anime, The Apothecary Diaries , with its third season on Crunchyroll.
author: ComicBook
